infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Vela reads body weight, body fat percentage, heart rate, resting heart rate, heart rate variability, breathing rate, steps, VO₂ max, sleep and its stages, active energy and exercise minutes from Apple Health, so your physiotherapist can see how training is landing against your sleep and recovery. Your health data is never used for advertising and is never shared with third parties.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Vela does not write anything to Apple Health. iOS requires this description because the Health framework Vela uses to read your measurements also provides write access, which Vela never requests.

plugins.cameraPermission: Vela uses the camera only to read barcodes on food packaging. Nothing is photographed or stored.
